_comment: ATTACH, never start. dev.bat is what runs this project: it opens two
windows -- the engine on 8756 and Vite on 5173 -- so both logs stay visible,
and the engine is not optional (no engine, no tool runs at all).
This file used to say port 5188 with its own `npm run dev`, which meant an
agent asked to look at the app quietly raised a SECOND Vite on a second
port, beside the one already running. Both serve the same files from disk,
so both worked -- and that is what made it expensive: the verification came
from an address the photographer had never seen, while his own tab on 5173
was equally correct the whole time. Reported as 'what is this address, what
No runtimeExecutable on purpose. With a url and no command this attaches to
the server dev.bat already started. If nothing is listening on 5173 the
preview fails to open, which is the honest outcome: run dev.bat. Starting
another one, or letting the port bump, is how you get two servers again.
